description: This Python module provides utilities for rate limiting API calls, specifically designed with GitHub API considerations. It includes classes for a token bucket algorithm and a GitHub-aware rate limiter that adjusts request pacing based on GitHub's rate limit headers and implements exponential backoff on throttling responses.

classes.name: TokenBucket
classes.description: Implements a token bucket algorithm to control the rate of actions, with thread safety and optional injection of time and sleep functions for testing.

classes.name: GitHubRateLimiter
classes.description: A rate limiter that wraps around a TokenBucket and dynamically adjusts request pacing based on GitHub's rate limit headers, with support for exponential backoff on throttling responses.

methods.name: TokenBucket.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the token bucket with a refill rate, capacity, and optional custom time and sleep functions.

methods.name: TokenBucket._refill
methods.description: Refills tokens based on elapsed time since last refill.

methods.name: TokenBucket.acquire
methods.description: Blocks until a token is available to proceed.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the GitHub rate limiter with a token bucket, and optional custom sleep and time functions.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.acquire
methods.description: Delegates to the underlying token bucket to acquire permission for a request.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.update_from_headers
methods.description: Adjusts request pacing based on GitHub rate limit headers, sleeping until reset if necessary.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.backoff_on_throttle
methods.description: Implements exponential backoff delay when encountering throttling responses.

methods.name: GitHubRateLimiter.reset_backoff
methods.description: Resets the backoff delay counter after successful requests.
